fields.Name: RubricDriftPeriodMeans
fields.UserQuestion: How did each agent's rubric criterion mean change between the last two periods?
fields.Description: Mean normalized score per agent, rubric, and criterion for two time windows. Counts only Submitted evaluations that are not self-checks, and only the evaluator's own scores.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups RubricEvaluationScore by AI Agent name, Rubric name, and criterion Key. previousStart, currentStart, and periodEnd ({{ previousStart | sqlDate }}, {{ currentStart | sqlDate }}, {{ periodEnd | sqlDate }}) bound the two windows [previousStart, currentStart) and [currentStart, periodEnd). Status is Submitted and EvaluatorType is not Self.
